pages.title: Long Tables
pages.text: These dining tables come in every wood type. Place matching tables side by side to build a larger table, or line them up on opposite sides to create a long banquet surface without gaps. There is also a tea table, which fills a two-by-two area when placed.

Want a little more style? Right-click a table with a carpet or tatami to lay down a tablecloth; shears take the cloth off again, and breaking a decorated table drops both the table and its cloth material.
